name: Dragon Claw Fist
description: Grip strikes that crush, taught by Revolutionary teachers to those with Strength 60.

stages.name: Grip strikes
stages.description: Strike with the fingers curled like a claw.
stages.text: Your fingers left marks in the stone.

stages.name: Crushing grip
stages.text: You crushed an iron bar in your hand.

stages.name: Crushing with haki
stages.description: A coated grip that breaks anything.
stages.text: Your coated fingers broke a wall like bread.
